messages.content:
Sarunyu has a stick of length 1 with one endpoint marked in red. Every minute, he picks one of his sticks uniformly at random and breaks it into two halves of equal length. Compute the expected length of the stick with the red endpoint after 5 minutes.

Put your final answer within \boxed{}.

message.content:
After each minute, the total number of sticks increases by 1. Thus before the \(i\)-th minute’s break, there are \(i\) sticks, exactly one of which has the red endpoint.

So at minute \(i\), the probability that the red stick is chosen is \(\frac1i\). If chosen, its length is halved; otherwise it stays the same. Therefore

\[
\mathbb{E}[L_i]=L_{i-1}\left(1-\frac{1}{2i}\right).
\]

Starting with \(L_0=1\),

\[
\mathbb{E}[L_5]=\prod_{i=1}^5 \left(1-\frac{1}{2i}\right)
=\frac12\cdot\frac34\cdot\frac56\cdot\frac78\cdot\frac9{10}.
\]

Compute:

\[
\frac{1\cdot3\cdot5\cdot7\cdot9}{2\cdot4\cdot6\cdot8\cdot10}
=\frac{945}{3840}
=\frac{63}{256}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{63}{256}}
\]
